sources.label: World Checklist of Vascular Plants
sources.authority: Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, and WCVP collaborators
sources.retryPolicy: No automatic retries; preserve failures and use a new acquisition identity after reviewing the cause.
sources.licensing: Inspect and retain this release's embedded metadata before reuse. Kew's terms defer data licensing to individual dataset metadata. An older GBIF-hosted WCVP release is CC BY 4.0, but that does not prove this snapshot's terms.
limitations: Acquisition creates no taxonomy acceptance, county determination, research-completion outcome, or applicability decision.
Exact names, authorship, accepted-name and parent relationships require a separately evaluated mapping method. Misapplied names, homonyms and ambiguous concepts remain unresolved.
A taxonomic relationship does not establish occurrence, establishment, introduced status, invasive impact or geographic absence.
RBG, Kew cannot warrant the quality or accuracy of the data; Project Isitusa has no endorsement or affiliation with Kew.
